name: codex-workflow
description: Operate the Aerox912 Codex Workflow fork through its installed, agent-system-managed runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Codex Workflow projects through the installed fork runtime
interface.longDescription: Codex Workflow adds explicit Light, Medium, and Heavy execution routes plus project lifecycle commands. This companion plugin routes those commands to the runtime installed and updated by agent-system; installing the plugin does not replace or self-update that runtime.
defaultPrompt: Install Codex Workflow in this project.
Check whether this project needs a Workflow update.
Configure the Codex Workflow route and workers for this project.
